test_commands: docker run --rm --entrypoint python "$IMAGE_REF" -c "from importlib.metadata import version; assert version('mcp') == '2.0.0'; assert version('substack-api') == '1.3.0'; assert version('markdownify') == '1.2.3'"
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$IMAGE_REF" -c "! command -v node && ! command -v mcp-proxy && ! command -v mcp-filter"

docker run --rm -d --name mcp-substack-test -p 18080:8080 $IMAGE_REF && bash test/test-native-mcp-image-smoke.sh mcp-substack-test 18080 mcp-contracts/mcp-substack.json && test "$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18080/ping)" = pong && docker stop mcp-substack-test || { docker rm -f mcp-substack-test 2>/dev/null || true; false; }
